interpretation: A-vs-B: giving the LLM runtime evidence raises defense judgment accuracy from 0.15 (blind) to 0.70 and the valid-judgment rate from 0.20 to 0.95. Blind mode mostly abstains (invalid) because it has no evidence. The 6 remaining evidence-mode disagreements are mostly a stricter LLM defense standard (any material latency counts as not_defended) rather than misjudgment. Root-cause family match (0.25) is a conservative floor: LLM attributes (circuit breaker/fail-fast/retry amplification) align in direction with card families (timeout/fallback) but use different wording.
